description: This file defines the NetworkStatus class, which monitors network connectivity status changes on Android devices. It manages network callbacks, handles registration and unregistration of network listeners, and communicates status changes via a native method.

classes.name: NetworkStatus
classes.description: A class to monitor and report network connectivity status changes, integrating with Android's ConnectivityManager and invoking native callbacks.

classes.name: CobaltNetworkCallback
classes.description: A nested class extending ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback to handle network loss and availability events, updating NetworkStatus accordingly.

methods.name: sendStatusChange
methods.description: Posts a runnable to the main thread handler to log and process network status changes.

methods.name: sendStatusChangeInternal
methods.description: Invokes a native method to notify about network status change.

methods.name: NetworkStatus
methods.description: Constructor initializing network monitoring, registering network callback.

methods.name: beforeStartOrResume
methods.description: Re-registers network callback if not already registered.

methods.name: beforeSuspend
methods.description: Unregisters network callback to suspend monitoring.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks current network capabilities to determine if device is connected via various transports.

methods.name: nativeOnNetworkStatusChange
methods.description: Native method called to notify status change.
